title: Tiny, cute umbrella
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Umbrella canopy -->
  <path d="M 50 20 Q 30 22 20 40 Q 30 38 38 42 Q 42 30 50 28 Q 58 30 62 42 Q 70 38 80 40 Q 70 22 50 20 Z" fill="#ff4d6d"/>
  <!-- Canopy highlights -->
  <path d="M 50 20 Q 40 22 35 32 Q 40 30 46 30 Q 48 25 50 23 Z" fill="#ff8fa3"/>
  <path d="M 50 20 Q 60 22 65 32 Q 60 30 54 30 Q 52 25 50 23 Z" fill="#ff8fa3"/>
  <!-- Scalloped edge -->
  <path d="M 20 40 Q 15 42 18 46 Q 22 44 24 42 Q 26 46 30 46 Q 34 46 36 42 Q 38 46 42 46 Q 46 46 48 42 L 50 28 L 52 42 Q 54 46 58 46 Q 62 46 64 42 Q 66 46 70 46 Q 74 46 76 42 Q 78 46 82 46 Q 86 44 80 40" fill="none" stroke="#ffd166" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Center pole -->
  <line x1="50" y1="30" x2="50" y2="78" stroke="#8ecae6" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Hook handle -->
  <path d="M 50 78 Q 50 88 42 88 Q 36 88 36 82" fill="none" stroke="#8ecae6" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="82" r="2.5" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <!-- Top finial -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="18" r="3.5" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="18" r="1.5" fill="#fff3b0"/>
  <!-- Cute raindrops -->
  <ellipse cx="22" cy="58" rx="2" ry="4" fill="#48cae4"/>
  <ellipse cx="76" cy="55" rx="2" ry="4" fill="#48cae4"/>
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="70" rx="1.8" ry="3.5" fill="#90e0ef"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="68" rx="1.8" ry="3.5" fill="#90e0ef"/>
  <!-- Tiny smiley face on canopy -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="34" r="1.5" fill="#fff3b0"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="34" r="1.5" fill="#fff3b0"/>
  <path d="M 46 37 Q 50 40 54 37" fill="none" stroke="#fff3b0" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
